note: Cassini PIA17652 false-color polar mosaic on a shallow idealized spherical cap. The jet’s visible across-corners width is registered approximately to the catalog 25,000 km; the surrounding circular aperture is context and extends to about 1.28×. This is approximate image registration, not a georeferenced latitude/longitude map. Colors combine ultraviolet, visible and infrared wavelengths and are not natural vision. Geometry shows planetary curvature only, not measured cloud heights. The source is a 2012 image, not current weather or a six-sided solid object.
